understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid to complete every goal cell in each level. A goal cell can only be completed by stepping onto it while the carried piece exactly matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; completing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Movement is blocked by walls, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen because they waste a turn and stamina without moving. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the piece: shape changers cycle shapes 0–5 (wrap), color changers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation changers rotate 90° clockwise through 0°/90°/180°/270° (wrap). A goal only activates (and can be completed) when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously; stamina refill tiles restore stamina. Efficient routing and avoiding blocked moves are crucial due to limited stamina/lives/turn budget.
